bitterly too. He managed, as he ran, to snatch up a piece of red brick that lay on the snow
of the path, to fling it at the flock of sparrows that was flying by. He missed them, of course,
and went on crying as he ran. Half-way, Snegiryov suddenly stopped, stood still for half a minute,
as though struck by something and suddenly turning back to the church ran towards the

and wailing, he began crying out, Ilusha, old man, dear old man. Alyosha and Kolya tried to
